name: Cleanarr
description: Smart media library cleanup and storage optimization for the *Arr ecosystem. Cleanarr connects to Sonarr and Radarr, reads watch history from Plex and requests from Seerr (Overseerr/Jellyseerr), evaluates your rules against your library, and removes, unmonitors, or deletes the files of items that match. Safe by default: dry-run, approval queue, live revalidation before every write, fail-closed rules and a full audit trail.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Host port for the Cleanarr web UI and API (the container listens on 8080).

variables.name: API Key
variables.description: Protects the UI and API. Strongly recommended: set a long random value.

variables.name: Secret Key
variables.description: Encrypts stored Sonarr/Radarr/Plex/Seerr API keys. If empty, one is generated in /data/secret.key.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: IANA timezone (e.g. Europe/London) used for the scheduled run time. Defaults to UTC if empty.

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: trace, debug, info, warn or error.
